_about: Input side of the Part 2 test set: five weekly team meetings at Brightwater Plumbing & Heating (fictional), Mondays 7 Sep - 5 Oct 2026. Each meeting is a list of turns. 'text' is written for the TTS engine (hard names spelled phonetically). The correct answers live in labels.json.

_fields.voices: team member -> Piper speaker id in en_GB-vctk-medium

meetings.about: Baseline: four clear new tasks, one task with no owner (van), one explicit non-task (website).

Yes, I'll send it by Wednesday.
Great. Tom, the boiler at Mill Lane needs a new pressure valve. Can you order the part today?
Sure, I'll order it this afternoon.
Jamie, you're on the Station Road leak for Dave on Thursday.

Also, the van insurance renewal is due at the end of the month. I'll handle that.
Thanks. About the new website, let's leave it for now. We'll talk about it another month.

meetings.about: Three tasks closed, the ownerless van task gets an owner, a follow-up task appears, and one owner is only knowable from the voice ('I'll book that in').

meetings.about: Two tasks closed, a NEW Gallagher quote task that looks like the old one, an owner change (Ellis booking), a re-mention with no change (insurance), and a task with no date.

meetings.about: Three tasks closed, one task CANCELLED (Mill Lane follow-up), two new tasks, one of them a consequence of a closed one (gas check booked -> do the check).
turns: I renewed it on Friday. And the revised Gallagher quote went out on Thursday. She's accepted it.

meetings.about: Two tasks closed and three new ones, including the website idea from meeting 1 finally becoming a task, and a task assigned by Priya rather than Sam.
